title: Rebase lte_nr_coex2 onto origin/master + cherry-pick RAT-N5 (6ca8f30)
description: THE GATE. Rebase onto origin/master (142 commits: latest open5gs/kamailio + upstream VoWiFi/ePDG + N5 refactor), then cherry-pick voip_and_inter_rat 6ca8f30 (RAT N5). title: Re-land RAT decision/persistence layer on upstream N5 (one commit)
description: Our differentiator vs upstream's coarser stacked-ifdef N5. On top of upstream mo.cfg/mt.cfg/register.cfg: (1) runtime per-call N5-vs-Rx PRIMARY selection from P-Access-Network-Info (wrap stacked WITH_RX/WITH_N5 in if(reg_tech)); (2) IMPU-keyed sub_tech htable + PANI-absent fallback for in-dialog/MT (upstream keys on source IP only); (3) S-CSCF IMPI->tech (from 32cd768); (4) DEPLOY_MODE=ALL dual-stack (from 247b289). 9 old commits -> 1.
notes: Lesson from discarded working-tree debug of old implementation: in WITHINDLG MSISDN->IMPI lookup, the IMS domain was hardcoded (sip:$rU@ims.mnc001.mcc001.3gppnetwork.org); fix was templating it as @NETWORKNAME substituted by init script. When re-landing the decision layer, template all domain references — never hardcode mnc/mcc.

title: Cleanup branch cruft + discard WiFi-calling WIP (incl. dhcp/)
description: Pre-rebase hygiene on lte_nr_coex2. DISCARD (user confirmed dhcp was for the abandoned ePDG attempt; upstream's osmo-epdg gets UE IPs from SMF via GTP-C — no DHCP in that architecture): dhcp/, osmoepdg/, strongswan/, sub_mgmt/, plus back out the uncommitted dhcp4 service block in deploy-all.yaml and DHCP4_IP/DHCP6_IP lines in .env. ALSO rm cruft: deploy-all.yaml.bak, mysql/mysql_init.sh.bak{,2}, mysql-test, mysql-test2, srsgnb2.yaml (verify vs srsgnb.yaml first), scscf/websocker.cfg. Then stash remaining bench-specific working-tree changes (.env RashedNet/host-IP, gnb.yml B210 serial=8003310+external clock, enb.conf) as LOCAL overrides to re-apply post-rebase. NOTE: nothing dhcp-related was ever committed — it lives only in working tree.

title: eSIM (GSMA RSP) support via osmo-smdpp + test eUICC
description: Feasible ONLY with programmable test eUICCs, NOT consumer-phone built-in eSIMs (GSMA CI trust chain: osmo-smdpp signs with SGP.26 TEST CI, production eUICCs reject). MVP: osmo-smdpp (already in pySim toolchain) + lpac LPA + sysmoEUICC1-C2T (~EUR95) + PCSC reader; build test profile with IMSI/K/OPc MATCHING open5gs UDM/UDR(mysql)+pyHSS; gen activation code, download via lpac. Effort M, hardware-gated. ACTION: order sysmoEUICC1-C2T early (long pole).

title: Add SIP+MSRP to IMS stack for RCS chat
description: Kamailio has native msrp relay but it's in exclude_modules in ims_base/modules.lst (NOT compiled). MVP: move msrp to include_modules, rebuild docker_kamailio, add TCP/TLS listener + event_route[msrp:frame-in]{msrp_relay();} on P-CSCF, test 1:1 chat/file-transfer with two SIP/MSRP soft clients (Blink/Jitsi). Effort M. NOTE: full GSMA RCS-UP (presence/rls/xcap/group-chat/autoconfig) is L-XL; real RCS clients (Google Messages) CANNOT register against lab IMS (Jibe-only) — scope to generic SIP/MSRP clients.

title: Finish LTE & NR IMS coexistence (verify cross-RAT calling)
description: Largely delivered by the rebase + re-landed decision layer. Remaining = integration test: register one LTE UE (Rx) and one NR UE (N5) to the same P-CSCF in DEPLOY_MODE=ALL, place LTE<->NR calls both directions, confirm correct policy interface chosen per UE and PANI-absent in-dialog/MT fallback works. Effort S-M.

title: VoNR call between two devices on one USRP B210
description: NOT a capacity/routing problem — 2x AMR-WB 5QI-1 ~110kbps on 51-PRB/20MHz n78 is trivial; IMS already routes UE<->UE VoNR (S-CSCF orig->term loopback + N5/5QI-1 + rtpengine present). REAL WORK = B210 RF/timing: keep external clock/GPSDO, run srsran_performance (avoid Late/underflow), TX power ~16dBm (may need amp), provision 2 IMS subscribers (IMSI/K/OPc in mysql UDM/UDR + pyHSS IMPU/IMPI). No IMS code changes expected. Effort S-M.

value: Upstream herlesupreeth/docker_open5gs (origin) has been building the SAME features as our lte_nr_coex2 branch in parallel and is now AHEAD: N5/RAT IMS routing (branch voip_and_inter_rat, commit 6ca8f30), VoWiFi/ePDG (custom strongswan-epdg fork + swu_client, fully wired), LTE/NR-coex radio configs (our srslte/gnb.conf is byte-identical to theirs), expanded qos.yml. Branch is 22 ahead/142 behind as of merge-base aadca6b (2025-03-24). Rebase strategy = adopt upstream as foundation, re-land only our thin RAT decision/persistence layer. Our genuine differentiator vs upstream: runtime per-call N5-vs-Rx PRIMARY selection + IMPU-keyed sub_tech htable with PANI-absent fallback (upstream only keys on source IP). Always check upstream before reimplementing IMS features here.
